title: Maxim Group Raises Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $210.00
text:
Maxim Group Raises Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $210.00 Posted by Caroline Horne | Feb 5th, 2018 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target boosted by Maxim Group from $204.00 to $210.00 in a research report released on Friday. Maxim Group currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
“Normalized iPhone revenue sell-out up ~17% y/y; our ASP analysis suggests iPhone X represented 20% of the December quarter iPhone mix. Guidance embeds iPhone unit & revenue sell-out accelerates, even on a normalized basis. Bottom line power of iPhone X still not evident, but we continue to also model erosion of the iPhone X price premium in FY19, leading us to continue to utilize normalized valuation. Continue to utilize a normalized earnings framework, though increasing 12- month price target to $210, from $204, due to a lower tax rate than we had assumed new tax law would enable.”,” Maxim Group’s analyst commented. Other research analysts have also issued reports about the company. Piper Jaffray Companies reissued a buy rating and issued a $196.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 11th. Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating and set a $175.00 price objective on the stock in a research report on Wednesday, October 11th. Morgan Stanley reissued a buy rating and issued a $199.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 11th. Drexel Hamilton reissued a buy rating and issued a $208.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. Finally, UBS Group reissued a buy rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 9th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fourteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-five have assigned a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The company has a consensus rating of Buy and an average target price of $202.53. 
Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $160.50 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple has a 52-week low of $128.16 and a 52-week high of $180.10. The company has a market capitalization of $824,060.00, a PE ratio of 16.51, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.84% and a net margin of 21.13%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the company posted $3.36 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.3 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be issued a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date is Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.57%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 25.93%.

The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. Cue sold 65,361 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Thursday, November 30th. The shares were sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total value of $11,215,947.60. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 in the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.

FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the period.
